translations.idiomatic: Again north of Ji city an altar was set up and the Horse Ancestor sacrificed upon it, also with burning.

sentences.zh: 又於其日，使有司並祭先牧及馬步，無鐘鼓之樂。

translations.literal: Again on that day the relevant office also sacrificed to the Former Herdsman and Horse Steps, without bells and drums.
translations.idiomatic: Again on that day the relevant office also sacrificed to the Former Herdsman and Horse Steps, without bells and drums.

sentences.zh: 眾軍將發，帝禦臨朔宮，親授節度。

translations.literal: When the armies were about to depart, the emperor presided at Linshuo Palace and personally conferred command authority.
translations.idiomatic: When the armies were about to depart, the emperor presided at Linshuo Palace and personally conferred command authority.

sentences.zh: 每軍大將、亞將各一人。

translations.literal: Each army had one grand general and one vice general.
translations.idiomatic: Each army had one grand general and one vice general.

sentences.zh: 騎兵四十隊。

translations.literal: Cavalry forty companies.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry forty companies.

sentences.zh: 隊百人置一纛。

translations.literal: Each company of one hundred men had one banner.
translations.idiomatic: Each company of one hundred men had one banner.

sentences.zh: 十隊為團，團有偏將一人。

translations.literal: Ten companies formed a regiment; each regiment had one deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: Ten companies formed a regiment; each regiment had one deputy general.

sentences.zh: 第一團，皆青絲連明光甲、鐵具裝、青纓拂，建狻猊旗。

translations.literal: The first regiment all wore green silk linked bright armor, iron full armor, green tassel whisks, and bore suanni banners.
translations.idiomatic: The first regiment all wore green silk linked bright armor, iron full armor, green tassel whisks, and bore suanni banners.

sentences.zh: 第二團，絳絲連硃犀甲、獸文具裝、赤纓拂，建貔貅旗。

translations.literal: The second regiment wore crimson silk linked vermilion rhinoceros armor, beast-pattern full armor, red tassel whisks, and bore pixiu banners.
translations.idiomatic: The second regiment wore crimson silk linked vermilion rhinoceros armor, beast-pattern full armor, red tassel whisks, and bore pixiu banners.

sentences.zh: 第三團，白絲連明光甲、鐵具裝、素纓拂，建辟邪旗。

translations.literal: The third regiment wore white silk linked bright armor, iron full armor, plain tassel whisks, and bore bixie banners.
translations.idiomatic: The third regiment wore white silk linked bright armor, iron full armor, plain tassel whisks, and bore bixie banners.

sentences.zh: 第四團，烏絲連玄犀甲、獸文具裝、建纓拂，建六駁旗。

translations.literal: The fourth regiment wore black silk linked dark rhinoceros armor, beast-pattern full armor, black tassel whisks, and bore liubo banners.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth regiment wore black silk linked dark rhinoceros armor, beast-pattern full armor, black tassel whisks, and bore liubo banners.

sentences.zh: 前部鼓吹一部，大鼓、小鼓及鼙、長鳴、中鳴等各十八具，穥鼓、金鉦各二具。

translations.literal: The vanguard had one section of wind and percussion music: large drums, small drums, pi drums, long horns, and middle horns eighteen each; hu drums and golden chimes two each.
translations.idiomatic: The vanguard had one section of wind and percussion music: large drums, small drums, pi drums, long horns, and middle horns eighteen each; hu drums and golden chimes two each.

sentences.zh: 後部鐃吹一部，鐃二面，歌簫及笳各四具，節鼓一面，吳吹篳篥、橫笛各四具，大角十八具。

translations.literal: The rear had one section of nao wind music: two nao faces, four each of song pipes and horns, one rhythm drum, four each of Wu-style bili and transverse flutes, eighteen great horns.
translations.idiomatic: The rear had one section of nao wind music: two nao faces, four each of song pipes and horns, one rhythm drum, four each of Wu-style bili and transverse flutes, eighteen great horns.

sentences.zh: 又步卒八十隊，分為四團。

translations.literal: Also eighty companies of foot soldiers, divided into four regiments.
translations.idiomatic: Also eighty companies of foot soldiers, divided into four regiments.

sentences.zh: 團有偏將一人。

translations.literal: Each regiment had one deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: Each regiment had one deputy general.

sentences.zh: 第一團，每隊給青隼蕩幡一。

translations.literal: The first regiment, each company given one green falcon swaying banner.
translations.idiomatic: The first regiment, each company given one green falcon swaying banner.

sentences.zh: 第二團，每隊黃隼蕩幡一。

translations.literal: The second regiment, each company one yellow falcon swaying banner.
translations.idiomatic: The second regiment, each company one yellow falcon swaying banner.

sentences.zh: 第三團，每隊白隼蕩幡一。

translations.literal: The third regiment, each company one white falcon swaying banner.
translations.idiomatic: The third regiment, each company one white falcon swaying banner.

sentences.zh: 第四團，每隊蒼隼蕩幡一。

translations.literal: The fourth regiment, each company one dark falcon swaying banner.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth regiment, each company one dark falcon swaying banner.

sentences.zh: 長槊楯弩及甲毦等，各稱兵數。

translations.literal: Long spears, shields, crossbows, armor, and feather ornaments each matched the number of troops.
translations.idiomatic: Long spears, shields, crossbows, armor, and feather ornaments each matched the number of troops.

sentences.zh: 受降使者一人，給二馬軺車一乘，白獸幡及節各一，騎吏三人，車輻白從十二人。

translations.literal: One envoy to receive surrender was given one two-horse light carriage, one white beast banner and staff each, three mounted clerks, twelve white-followers on the carriage shaft.
translations.idiomatic: One envoy to receive surrender was given one two-horse light carriage, one white beast banner and staff each, three mounted clerks, twelve white-followers on the carriage shaft.

sentences.zh: 承詔慰撫，不受大將制。

translations.literal: By edict he comforted and pacified; he was not subject to the grand general's command.
translations.idiomatic: By edict he comforted and pacified; he was not subject to the grand general's command.

sentences.zh: 戰陣則為監軍。

translations.literal: In battle he served as supervising army.
translations.idiomatic: In battle he served as supervising army.

sentences.zh: 軍將發，候大角一通，步卒第一團出營東門，東向陣。

translations.literal: When the army was about to depart, at one blast of the great horn the first regiment of foot soldiers left the camp east gate and formed facing east.
translations.idiomatic: When the army was about to depart, at one blast of the great horn the first regiment of foot soldiers left the camp east gate and formed facing east.

sentences.zh: 第二團出營南門，南向陣。

translations.literal: The second regiment left the south gate, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The second regiment left the south gate, facing south.

sentences.zh: 第三團出營西門，西向陣。

translations.literal: The third regiment left the west gate, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The third regiment left the west gate, facing west.

sentences.zh: 第四團出營北門，北向陣。

translations.literal: The fourth regiment left the north gate, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth regiment left the north gate, facing north.

sentences.zh: 陣四麵團營，然後諸團嚴駕立。

translations.literal: The formation on four sides in regimental camp complete, then all regiments stood in full array.
translations.idiomatic: The formation on four sides in regimental camp complete, then all regiments stood in full array.

sentences.zh: 大角三通，則鐃鼓俱振，騎第一團引行。

translations.literal: At three blasts of the great horn, nao drums all sounded and the first cavalry regiment led the march.
translations.idiomatic: At three blasts of the great horn, nao drums all sounded and the first cavalry regiment led the march.

sentences.zh: 隊間相去各十五步。

translations.literal: Between companies the distance was fifteen paces each.
translations.idiomatic: Between companies the distance was fifteen paces each.

sentences.zh: 次第二團，次前部鼓吹，次弓矢一隊，合二百騎。

translations.literal: Next the second regiment, next the vanguard wind music, next one company of bowmen totaling two hundred cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Next the second regiment, next the vanguard wind music, next one company of bowmen totaling two hundred cavalry.

sentences.zh: 建蹲獸旗，瓟槊二張，大將在其下。

translations.literal: Bearing the crouching beast banner, two bo spears; the grand general was below them.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing the crouching beast banner, two bo spears; the grand general was below them.

sentences.zh: 次誕馬二十匹，次大角，次後部鐃，次第三團，次第四團，次受降使者。

translations.literal: Next twenty ceremonial horses, next the great horn, next the rear nao, next the third regiment, next the fourth regiment, next the envoy to receive surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Next twenty ceremonial horses, next the great horn, next the rear nao, next the third regiment, next the fourth regiment, next the envoy to receive surrender.

sentences.zh: 次及輜重戎車散兵等，亦有四團。

translations.literal: Next supply wagons, war chariots, and scattered troops also had four regiments.
translations.idiomatic: Next supply wagons, war chariots, and scattered troops also had four regiments.

sentences.zh: 第一輜重出，收東面陣，分為兩道，夾以行。

translations.literal: The first supply train departed, gathering the east-facing formation, split into two columns flanking the march.
translations.idiomatic: The first supply train departed, gathering the east-facing formation, split into two columns flanking the march.

sentences.zh: 第二輜重出，收南面陣，夾以行。

translations.literal: The second supply train departed, gathering the south-facing formation, flanking the march.
translations.idiomatic: The second supply train departed, gathering the south-facing formation, flanking the march.

sentences.zh: 第三輜重出，收西面陣，夾以行。

translations.literal: The third supply train departed, gathering the west-facing formation, flanking the march.
translations.idiomatic: The third supply train departed, gathering the west-facing formation, flanking the march.

sentences.zh: 第四輜重出，收北面陣，夾以行。

translations.literal: The fourth supply train departed, gathering the north-facing formation, flanking the march.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth supply train departed, gathering the north-facing formation, flanking the march.

sentences.zh: 亞將領五百騎，建騰豹旗，殿軍後。

translations.literal: The vice general led five hundred cavalry, bore the soaring leopard banner, and brought up the rear.
translations.idiomatic: The vice general led five hundred cavalry, bore the soaring leopard banner, and brought up the rear.

sentences.zh: 至營，則第一團騎陣於東面，第二團騎陣於南面，鼓吹翊大將居中，駐馬南向。

translations.literal: Upon reaching camp, the first cavalry regiment formed on the east, the second on the south, wind music flanking the grand general in the center, horses halted facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching camp, the first cavalry regiment formed on the east, the second on the south, wind music flanking the grand general in the center, horses halted facing south.

sentences.zh: 第三團騎陣於西面，第四團騎陣於北面，合為方陣。

translations.literal: The third cavalry regiment formed on the west, the fourth on the north, together forming a square formation.
translations.idiomatic: The third cavalry regiment formed on the west, the fourth on the north, together forming a square formation.

sentences.zh: 四團外向，步卒翊輜重入於陣內，以次安營。

translations.literal: The four regiments faced outward; foot soldiers flanking supply wagons entered within the formation, and camps were set in order.
translations.idiomatic: The four regiments faced outward; foot soldiers flanking supply wagons entered within the formation, and camps were set in order.

sentences.zh: 營定，四面陣者，引騎入營。

translations.literal: When camp was set, those in the four-sided formation led cavalry into camp.
translations.idiomatic: When camp was set, those in the four-sided formation led cavalry into camp.

sentences.zh: 亞將率驍騎游弈督察。

translations.literal: The vice general led elite cavalry on patrol and inspection.
translations.idiomatic: The vice general led elite cavalry on patrol and inspection.

sentences.zh: 其安營之制，以車外布，間設馬槍，次施兵幕，內安雜畜。

translations.literal: The camp arrangement system: outside the carts was the outer perimeter, horse lances set at intervals, then military tents, inside which miscellaneous livestock were kept.
translations.idiomatic: The camp arrangement system: outside the carts was the outer perimeter, horse lances set at intervals, then military tents, inside which miscellaneous livestock were kept.

sentences.zh: 事畢，大將、亞將等，各就牙帳。

translations.literal: When affairs were complete, the grand general, vice general, and others each went to their command tents.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs were complete, the grand general, vice general, and others each went to their command tents.

sentences.zh: 其馬步隊與軍中散兵，交為兩番，五日而代。

translations.literal: Cavalry and foot companies and scattered troops in the army alternated in two shifts, replacing every five days.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry and foot companies and scattered troops in the army alternated in two shifts, replacing every five days.

sentences.zh: 於是每日遣一軍發，相去四十裏， 連營漸進。

translations.literal: Thereupon each day one army was dispatched, forty li apart, camps advancing in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon each day one army was dispatched, forty li apart, camps advancing in succession.

sentences.zh: 二十四日續發而盡。

translations.literal: In twenty-four days dispatch was complete.
translations.idiomatic: In twenty-four days dispatch was complete.

sentences.zh: 首尾相繼，鼓角相聞，旌旗亙九百六十裏。

translations.literal: Head and tail linked in succession; drums and horns heard one another; banners and flags stretched nine hundred sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: Head and tail linked in succession; drums and horns heard one another; banners and flags stretched nine hundred sixty li.

sentences.zh: 天子六軍次發，兩部前後先置，又亙八十裏。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven's six armies departed next, both sections placed front and rear, again stretching eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven's six armies departed next, both sections placed front and rear, again stretching eighty li.

sentences.zh: 通諸道合三十軍，亙一千四十裏。

translations.literal: All routes together thirty armies, stretching one thousand forty li.
translations.idiomatic: All routes together thirty armies, stretching one thousand forty li.

sentences.zh: 諸軍各以帛為帶，長尺五寸，闊二寸，題其軍號為記。

translations.literal: Each army used silk as a band, one chi five cun long and two cun wide, inscribed with its army designation as mark.
translations.idiomatic: Each army used silk as a band, one chi five cun long and two cun wide, inscribed with its army designation as mark.

sentences.zh: 禦營內者，合十二衛、三台、五省、九寺，並分隸內外前後左右六軍，亦各題其軍號，不得自言台省。

translations.literal: Those within the imperial camp included the twelve guards, three platforms, five ministries, and nine courts, all assigned to the inner, outer, front, rear, left, and right six armies, also inscribed with army designations, not permitted to name their platform or ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Those within the imperial camp included the twelve guards, three platforms, five ministries, and nine courts, all assigned to the inner, outer, front, rear, left, and right six armies, also inscribed with army designations, not permitted to name their platform or ministry.

sentences.zh: 王公已下，至於兵丁廝隸，悉以帛為帶，綴於衣領，名「軍記帶」。

translations.literal: From princes and dukes down to soldiers and servants, all used silk as a band attached to the collar, called "army record band."
translations.idiomatic: From princes and dukes down to soldiers and servants, all used silk as a band attached to the collar, called "army record band."

sentences.zh: 諸軍並給幡數百，有事，使人交相去來者，執以行。

translations.literal: All armies were also given several hundred banners; when business required messengers going back and forth, they carried banners when traveling.
translations.idiomatic: All armies were also given several hundred banners; when business required messengers going back and forth, they carried banners when traveling.

sentences.zh: 不執幡而離本軍者，他軍驗軍記帶，知非部兵，則所在斬之。

translations.literal: Those who left their own army without carrying a banner—other armies checking the army record band and finding they were not unit troops were executed on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Those who left their own army without carrying a banner—other armies checking the army record band and finding they were not unit troops were executed on the spot.

sentences.zh: 是歲也，行幸望海鎮，于禿黎山為壇，祀黃帝，行祃祭。

translations.literal: That year, progressing to Wanghai garrison, on Tuli Mountain an altar was built to sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor and perform the ma rite.
translations.idiomatic: That year, progressing to Wanghai garrison, on Tuli Mountain an altar was built to sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor and perform the ma rite.

sentences.zh: 詔太常少卿韋霽、博士褚亮奏定其禮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Vice Minister of Ceremonies Wei Ji and Doctor Chu Liang to submit and fix the rite.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Vice Minister of Ceremonies Wei Ji and Doctor Chu Liang to submit and fix the rite.

sentences.zh: 皇帝及諸預祭臣近侍官諸軍將，皆齋一宿。

translations.literal: The emperor and all officials participating in the sacrifice, close attendants, and army generals all fasted one night.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor and all officials participating in the sacrifice, close attendants, and army generals all fasted one night.

sentences.zh: 有司供帳設位，為埋坎神坐西北，內壝之外。

translations.literal: The relevant office supplied tents and set seats; the spirit seat for burial pit was northwest, outside the inner enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office supplied tents and set seats; the spirit seat for burial pit was northwest, outside the inner enclosure.

sentences.zh: 建二旗于南門外。

translations.literal: Two banners were erected outside the south gate.
translations.idiomatic: Two banners were erected outside the south gate.

sentences.zh: 以熊席設帝軒轅神坐於壝內，置甲胄弓矢於坐側，建槊於坐後。

translations.literal: On bear skin the emperor's Xuanyuan spirit seat was set within the enclosure; armor, bow, and arrows were placed beside the seat; a spear was erected behind the seat.
translations.idiomatic: On bear skin the emperor's Xuanyuan spirit seat was set within the enclosure; armor, bow, and arrows were placed beside the seat; a spear was erected behind the seat.

sentences.zh: 皇帝出次入門，群官定位，皆再拜奠。

translations.literal: The emperor left the pavilion, entered the gate; all officials took positions and all bowed twice in offering.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor left the pavilion, entered the gate; all officials took positions and all bowed twice in offering.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，還宮。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 隋制，常以仲春，用少牢祭馬祖於大澤，諸預祭官，皆於祭所致齋一日，積柴於燎壇，禮畢，就燎。

translations.literal: Under Sui regulations, regularly in mid-spring a lesser complement of sacrificial animals was used to sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor at the Great Marsh; all officials participating in the sacrifice fasted one day at the sacrifice site; firewood was piled on the burning altar; when the rite was complete, they proceeded to the burning.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui regulations, regularly in mid-spring a lesser complement of sacrificial animals was used to sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor at the Great Marsh; all officials participating in the sacrifice fasted one day at the sacrifice site; firewood was piled on the burning altar; when the rite was complete, they proceeded to the burning.

sentences.zh: 仲夏祭先牧，仲秋祭馬社，仲冬祭馬步，並於大澤，皆以剛日。

translations.literal: In mid-summer the Former Herdsman was sacrificed to; in mid-autumn the Horse Altar; in mid-winter the Horse Steps—all at the Great Marsh, all on yang days.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-summer the Former Herdsman was sacrificed to; in mid-autumn the Horse Altar; in mid-winter the Horse Steps—all at the Great Marsh, all on yang days.

sentences.zh: 牲用少牢，如祭馬祖，埋而不燎。

translations.literal: Victims used the lesser complement, as when sacrificing to the Horse Ancestor; buried without burning.
translations.idiomatic: Victims used the lesser complement, as when sacrificing to the Horse Ancestor; buried without burning.

sentences.zh: 開皇二十年，太慰晉王廣北伐突厥，四月己未，次於河上，祃祭軒轅黃帝，乙太牢制幣，陳甲兵，行三獻之禮。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Kaihuang, Grand Minister Prince Jin Guang marched north against the Turks; on day jiwei of the fourth month he stopped on the river, performed the ma sacrifice to Xuanyuan the Yellow Emperor, used a full complement of sacrificial animals and silks, displayed armor and weapons, and performed the three offerings rite.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang 20 (600), Grand Minister Prince Jin Guang marched north against the Turks; on jiwei day of the fourth month he stopped on the river, performed the ma sacrifice to Xuanyuan the Yellow Emperor, used a full complement of sacrificial animals and silks, displayed armor and weapons, and performed the three offerings rite.

sentences.zh: 後齊命將出征，則太卜詣太廟，灼靈龜，授鼓旗於廟。

translations.literal: Later Qi when appointing a general for expedition, the Grand Diviner went to the Grand Temple, scorched the spirit turtle, and conferred drum and banner at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qi when appointing a general for expedition, the Grand Diviner went to the Grand Temple, scorched the spirit turtle, and conferred drum and banner at the temple.

translations.literal: The emperor arranged the imperial carriage, wore coronation robes, came to the temple, and bowed to the Founding Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor arranged the imperial carriage, wore coronation robes, came to the temple, and bowed to the Founding Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 」將軍既受斧鉞，對曰：「國不可從外理，軍不可從中制。

translations.literal: The emperor pushed the wheel hub and measured the barrier, saying: "From here outward, the general commands."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pushed the wheel hub and measured the barrier, saying: "From here outward, the general commands."

sentences.zh: 周大將出征，遣太祝，以羊一，祭所過名山大川。

translations.idiomatic: Zhou when a grand general went on expedition dispatched the Grand Invocator with one sheep to sacrifice at famous mountains and great rivers passed along the route.

sentences.zh: 明帝武成元年，吐谷渾寇邊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wucheng of Emperor Ming, Tuyuhun raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: In Wucheng 1 (572), Tuyuhun raided the border.

sentences.zh: 帝常服乘馬，遣大司馬賀蘭祥于太祖之廟，司憲奉鉞，進授大將。

translations.literal: The emperor in regular dress rode a horse and dispatched Grand Marshal Helan Xiang to the Founding Ancestor's temple; the Director of Punishments presented the halberd and advanced to confer it on the grand general.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in regular dress rode a horse and dispatched Grand Marshal Helan Xiang to the Founding Ancestor's temple; the Director of Punishments presented the halberd and advanced to confer it on the grand general.

sentences.zh: 大將拜受，以授從者。

translations.literal: The grand general bowed to receive it and passed it to his attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The grand general bowed to receive it and passed it to his attendants.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，出受甲兵。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, he went out to receive armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, he went out to receive armor and weapons.

sentences.zh: 隋制，皇太子親戎，及大將出師，則以豭肫一釁鼓，皆告社廟。

translations.literal: Under Sui regulations, when the crown prince personally took command of troops or a grand general departed on campaign, a pig's shank was used to anoint the drum; all were announced at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui regulations, when the crown prince personally took command of troops or a grand general departed on campaign, a pig's shank was used to anoint the drum; all were announced at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 受斧鉞訖，不得反宿於家。

translations.literal: When axe and halberd were received, one must not return to sleep at home.
translations.idiomatic: When axe and halberd were received, one must not return to sleep at home.

sentences.zh: 開皇八年，晉王廣將伐陳，內史令李德林攝太尉，告于太祖廟。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kaihuang, when Prince Jin Guang was about to attack Chen, Director of the Secretariat Li Delin acting as Grand Minister announced at the Founding Ancestor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang 8 (588), when Prince Jin Guang was about to attack Chen, Director of the Secretariat Li Delin acting as Grand Minister announced at the Founding Ancestor's temple.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，又命有司宜於太社。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, the relevant office was again ordered to perform the yi rite at the Grand Altar of Soil.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, the relevant office was again ordered to perform the yi rite at the Grand Altar of Soil.

sentences.zh: 古者三年練兵，入而振旅，至於春秋蒐浯，亦以講其事焉。

translations.literal: In antiquity weapons were trained for three years; entering the state the army was rallied; reaching spring and autumn the sou and you hunts also served to drill these affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity weapons were trained for three years; entering the state the army was rallied; reaching spring and autumn the sou and you hunts also served to drill these affairs.

translations.literal: In Liang and Chen times, following Song Yuanjia twenty-five, the sou was held at Xuanwu Field.
translations.idiomatic: In Liang and Chen times, following Song Yuanjia 25 (448), the sou was held at Xuanwu Field.

sentences.zh: 其法，置行軍殿于幕府山南岡，並設王公百官幕。

translations.literal: The method: set the campaign hall south of the marshal's tent on the southern hill, and also set pavilions for princes, dukes, and hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: The method: set the campaign hall south of the marshal's tent on the southern hill, and also set pavilions for princes, dukes, and hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 先獵一日，遣馬騎布圍。

translations.literal: One day before the hunt, cavalry and horse riders were dispatched to spread the enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: One day before the hunt, cavalry and horse riders were dispatched to spread the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 右領軍將軍督右，左領軍將軍督左，大司馬董正諸軍。

translations.literal: The Right Commanding General supervised the right; the Left Commanding General supervised the left; the Grand Marshal supervised and corrected all armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Commanding General supervised the right; the Left Commanding General supervised the left; the Grand Marshal supervised and corrected all armies.

sentences.zh: 獵日，侍中三奏，一奏搥一鼓為嚴，三嚴訖，引仗為小駕鹵簿。

translations.literal: On the hunt day, the Attendant-in-Ordinary thrice announced; one announcement, one drumbeat for assembly; when three assemblies were complete, the guard was led as the small imperial procession.
translations.idiomatic: On the hunt day, the Attendant-in-Ordinary thrice announced; one announcement, one drumbeat for assembly; when three assemblies were complete, the guard was led as the small imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乘馬戎服，從者悉絳衫幘，黃麾警蹕，鼓吹如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor rode a horse in military dress; followers all wore crimson shirts and headcloths; yellow banners cleared the way; wind music as in regular ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode a horse in military dress; followers all wore crimson shirts and headcloths; yellow banners cleared the way; wind music as in regular ritual.

sentences.zh: 獵訖，宴會享勞，比校多少。

translations.literal: When the hunt was complete, a banquet was held to feast and reward, comparing quantities taken.
translations.idiomatic: When the hunt was complete, a banquet was held to feast and reward, comparing quantities taken.

sentences.zh: 戮一人以懲亂法。

translations.literal: One person was executed to punish violation of law.
translations.idiomatic: One person was executed to punish violation of law.

sentences.zh: 會畢，還宮。

translations.literal: When the assembly was complete, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the assembly was complete, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 後齊常以季秋，皇帝講武于都外。

translations.literal: Later Qi regularly in late autumn the emperor drilled troops outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qi regularly in late autumn the emperor drilled troops outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 有司先萊野為場，為二軍進止之節。

translations.literal: The relevant office first cleared the wild as a field and set markers for the two armies' advance and halt.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office first cleared the wild as a field and set markers for the two armies' advance and halt.

sentences.zh: 又別墠於北場，輿駕停觀。

translations.literal: Again a separate altar was made at the north field; the imperial carriage stopped to observe.
translations.idiomatic: Again a separate altar was made at the north field; the imperial carriage stopped to observe.

sentences.zh: 遂命將簡士，教眾為戰陣之法。

translations.literal: Then generals were ordered to select soldiers and teach the masses battle formation methods.
translations.idiomatic: Then generals were ordered to select soldiers and teach the masses battle formation methods.

sentences.zh: 凡為陣，少者在前，長者在後。

translations.literal: Generally for formations, the shorter were in front, the longer in back.
translations.idiomatic: Generally for formations, the shorter were in front, the longer in back.

sentences.zh: 其還，則長者在前，少者在後。

translations.literal: On return, the longer were in front, the shorter in back.
translations.idiomatic: On return, the longer were in front, the shorter in back.

sentences.zh: 長者持弓矢，短者持旌旗。

translations.literal: The longer held bows and arrows; the shorter held banners and flags.
translations.idiomatic: The longer held bows and arrows; the shorter held banners and flags.

sentences.zh: 勇者持鉦鼓刀楯，為前行，戰士次之，槊者次之，弓箭為後行。

translations.literal: The brave held gongs, drums, swords, and shields as vanguard; warriors next; spear men next; archers in the rear.
translations.idiomatic: The brave held gongs, drums, swords, and shields as vanguard; warriors next; spear men next; archers in the rear.

sentences.zh: 將帥先教士目，使習見旌旗指麾之蹤，發起之意，旗臥則跪。

translations.literal: Generals first taught the soldiers' eyes to accustom them to the tracks of banner and command gestures and the meaning of advance; when the banner lay down they knelt.
translations.idiomatic: Generals first taught the soldiers' eyes to accustom them to the tracks of banner and command gestures and the meaning of advance; when the banner lay down they knelt.

sentences.zh: 教士耳，使習金鼓動止之節，聲鼓則進，鳴金則止。

translations.literal: They taught the soldiers' ears to accustom them to the rhythm of gold and drum advance and halt; at drum sound they advanced, at bell sound they halted.
translations.idiomatic: They taught the soldiers' ears to accustom them to the rhythm of gold and drum advance and halt; at drum sound they advanced, at bell sound they halted.

sentences.zh: 教士心，使知刑罰之苦，賞賜之利。

translations.literal: They taught the soldiers' hearts to know the bitterness of punishment and the benefit of reward.
translations.idiomatic: They taught the soldiers' hearts to know the bitterness of punishment and the benefit of reward.

sentences.zh: 教士手，使習持五兵之便，戰鬥之備。

translations.literal: They taught the soldiers' hands to accustom them to holding the five weapons and preparing for battle.
translations.idiomatic: They taught the soldiers' hands to accustom them to holding the five weapons and preparing for battle.

sentences.zh: 教士足，使習跪及行列嶮泥之塗。

translations.literal: They taught the soldiers' feet to accustom them to kneeling and to ranks and dangerous muddy paths.
translations.idiomatic: They taught the soldiers' feet to accustom them to kneeling and to ranks and dangerous muddy paths.

sentences.zh: 前五日，皆請兵嚴於場所，依方色建旗為和門。

translations.literal: Five days before, all requested military assembly at the site; according to directional color banners were erected as harmony gates.
translations.idiomatic: Five days before, all requested military assembly at the site; according to directional color banners were erected as harmony gates.

sentences.zh: 都墠之中及四角，皆建五采牙旗。

translations.literal: At the center of the capital field and at the four corners, five-colored tusk banners were all erected.
translations.idiomatic: At the center of the capital field and at the four corners, five-colored tusk banners were all erected.

sentences.zh: 應講武者，各集於其軍。

translations.literal: Those who were to drill troops each assembled at their army.
translations.idiomatic: Those who were to drill troops each assembled at their army.

sentences.zh: 戒鼓一通，軍士皆嚴備。

translations.literal: At one warning drum, soldiers were all fully prepared.
translations.idiomatic: At one warning drum, soldiers were all fully prepared.

sentences.zh: 二通，將士貫甲。

translations.literal: At two, generals and soldiers donned armor.
translations.idiomatic: At two, generals and soldiers donned armor.

sentences.zh: 三通，步軍各為直陣以相俟。

translations.literal: At three, foot soldiers each formed straight formations to await one another.
translations.idiomatic: At three, foot soldiers each formed straight formations to await one another.

sentences.zh: 大將各處軍中，立旗鼓下。

translations.literal: Grand generals each stood in their army below banners and drums.
translations.idiomatic: Grand generals each stood in their army below banners and drums.

sentences.zh: 有司陳小駕鹵簿，皇帝武弁，乘革輅，大司馬介胄乘，奉引入行殿。

translations.idiomatic: The relevant office arranged the small imperial procession; the emperor in military cap rode the leather chariot; the Grand Marshal in armor rode, escorting him into the campaign hall.

sentences.zh: 百司陪列。

translations.literal: The hundred offices accompanied in array.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred offices accompanied in array.

sentences.zh: 位定，二軍迭為客主。

translations.literal: When positions were set, the two armies alternated as guest and host.
translations.idiomatic: When positions were set, the two armies alternated as guest and host.

sentences.zh: 先舉為客，後舉為主。

translations.literal: Whoever raised first was guest; whoever raised later was host.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever raised first was guest; whoever raised later was host.

sentences.zh: 從五行相勝法，為陣以應之。

translations.literal: Following the mutual conquest of the five phases, formations were made to respond.
translations.idiomatic: Following the mutual conquest of the five phases, formations were made to respond.

sentences.zh: 後齊春蒐禮，有司規大防，建獲旗，以表獲車。

translations.literal: Later Qi spring sou rite: the relevant office marked the great barrier, erected the capture banner to mark the capture cart.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qi spring sou rite: the relevant office marked the great barrier, erected the capture banner to mark the capture cart.

sentences.zh: 蒐前一日，命布圍。

translations.literal: One day before the sou, the enclosure was ordered spread.
translations.idiomatic: One day before the sou, the enclosure was ordered spread.

sentences.zh: 領軍將軍一人，督左甄，獲軍將軍一人，督右甄。

translations.literal: One Commanding General supervised the left wing; one Capturing Army General supervised the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: One Commanding General supervised the left wing; one Capturing Army General supervised the right wing.

sentences.zh: 大司馬一人，居中，節制諸軍。

translations.literal: One Grand Marshal stood in the center, controlling all armies.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Marshal stood in the center, controlling all armies.

sentences.zh: 天子陳小駕，服通天冠，乘木輅，詣行宮。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven arranged the small imperial procession, wore the tongtian cap, rode the wooden chariot, and proceeded to the campaign palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven arranged the small imperial procession, wore the tongtian cap, rode the wooden chariot, and proceeded to the campaign palace.

sentences.zh: 將親禽，服戎服，鈒戟者皆嚴。

translations.literal: About to hunt personally, he wore military dress; those with halberds were all in full array.
translations.idiomatic: About to hunt personally, he wore military dress; those with halberds were all in full array.

sentences.zh: 武衛張甄圍，旗鼓相望，銜枚而進。

translations.literal: Military guards spread the wing enclosures; banners and drums faced one another; they advanced with gag in mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Military guards spread the wing enclosures; banners and drums faced one another; they advanced with gag in mouth.

sentences.zh: 甄常開一方，以令三驅。

translations.literal: The wing regularly opened one side to permit the three drives.
translations.idiomatic: The wing regularly opened one side to permit the three drives.

translations.literal: When the enclosure closed, clerks on running horses proclaimed: "The flesh of birds and beasts not placed on the sacrificial tray is not to be shot.
translations.idiomatic: When the enclosure closed, clerks on running horses proclaimed: "The flesh of birds and beasts not placed on the sacrificial tray is not to be shot.

sentences.zh: 皮革齒牙，骨角毛羽，不登於器者不射。

translations.literal: Hide, teeth, bone, horn, hair, and feathers not placed in vessels are not to be shot.
translations.idiomatic: Hide, teeth, bone, horn, hair, and feathers not placed in vessels are not to be shot.

sentences.zh: 」甄合，大司馬鳴鼓促圍，眾軍鼓噪鳴角，至期處而止。

translations.idiomatic: When the wing closed, the Grand Marshal sounded the drum to urge the enclosure; all armies drummed, shouted, and sounded horns until the appointed place then halted.

translations.literal: The Grand Marshal halted at the north banner gate; the two wing commanders halted at the left and right banner gates.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Marshal halted at the north banner gate; the two wing commanders halted at the left and right banner gates.

sentences.zh: 天子乘馬，從南旌門入，親射禽。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven rode a horse, entered from the south banner gate, and hunted personally.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven rode a horse, entered from the south banner gate, and hunted personally.

translations.idiomatic: Attendants with the escort cart collected game; loaded and returned; displayed north of the escort banner.
