translations.literal: From princes and dukes down, each in order shot game, all sent to below the banner.
translations.idiomatic: From princes and dukes down, each in order shot game, all sent to below the banner.

sentences.zh: 事畢，大司馬鳴鼓解圍，複屯。

translations.literal: When affairs were complete, the Grand Marshal sounded the drum to release the enclosure; they again encamped.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs were complete, the Grand Marshal sounded the drum to release the enclosure; they again encamped.

sentences.zh: 殿中郎中率其屬收禽，以實護車。

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace led his subordinates to collect game and fill the escort cart.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Palace led his subordinates to collect game and fill the escort cart.

sentences.zh: 天子還行宮。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven returned to the campaign palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven returned to the campaign palace.

sentences.zh: 命有司每禽擇取三十，一曰幹豆，二曰賓客，三曰充君之皰。

translations.literal: The relevant office was ordered for each type of game to select thirty: first for dried provisions, second for guests, third to fill the ruler's stores.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office was ordered for each type of game to select thirty: first for dried provisions, second for guests, third to fill the ruler's stores.

sentences.zh: 其餘即於圍下量饣高將士。

translations.literal: The remainder was distributed below the enclosure to measure and reward officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder was distributed below the enclosure to measure and reward officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，改服，鈒者韜刃而還。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, garments were changed; those with halberds sheathed blades and returned.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, garments were changed; those with halberds sheathed blades and returned.

sentences.zh: 夏苗、秋獮、冬狩，禮皆同。

translations.literal: Summer miao, autumn xian, and winter shou rites were all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Summer miao, autumn xian, and winter shou rites were all the same.

sentences.zh: 河清中定令，每歲十二月半後講武，至晦逐除。

translations.literal: In Heqing the statute was fixed: every year from mid-twelfth month onward troops were drilled until the last day of the month for expulsion.
translations.idiomatic: In Heqing the statute was fixed: every year from mid-twelfth month onward troops were drilled until the last day of the month for expulsion.

sentences.zh: 二軍兵馬，右入千秋門，左入萬歲門，並至永巷南下，至昭陽殿北，二軍交。

translations.literal: The two armies' horses and troops: the right entered Qianqiu Gate, the left entered Wansui Gate, both reaching south below Yong Lane to north of Zhaoyang Hall; the two armies crossed.
translations.idiomatic: The two armies' horses and troops: the right entered Qianqiu Gate, the left entered Wansui Gate, both reaching south below Yong Lane to north of Zhaoyang Hall; the two armies crossed.

sentences.zh: 一軍從西上閣，一軍從東上閣，並從端門南，出閶闔門前橋南，戲射並訖，送至城南郭外罷。

translations.literal: One army from the west upper pavilion, one from the east upper pavilion, both from Duan Gate south, exiting before Changhe Gate bridge south; mock shooting complete, escorted to outside the southern outer wall and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: One army from the west upper pavilion, one from the east upper pavilion, both from Duan Gate south, exiting before Changhe Gate bridge south; mock shooting complete, escorted to outside the southern outer wall and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 後齊三月三日，皇帝常服乘輿，詣射所，升堂即坐，皇太子及群官坐定，登歌，進酒行爵。

translations.literal: Later Qi on the third day of the third month, the emperor in regular dress rode the carriage to the archery ground, ascended the hall and took seat; the crown prince and all officials when seated, ascending song, wine was presented and ranks conferred.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qi on the third day of the third month, the emperor in regular dress rode the carriage to the archery ground, ascended the hall and took seat; the crown prince and all officials when seated, ascending song, wine was presented and ranks conferred.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入便殿，更衣以出，驊騮令進禦馬，有司進弓矢。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the side hall, changed garments and came out; the Hualiu Commandant presented the imperial horse; the relevant office presented bow and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the side hall, changed garments and came out; the Hualiu Commandant presented the imperial horse; the relevant office presented bow and arrows.

sentences.zh: 帝射訖，還禦坐，射懸侯，又畢，群官乃射五埒。

translations.literal: When the emperor finished shooting, he returned to the imperial seat; shot at the suspended target; when again complete, all officials then shot five ranges.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor finished shooting, he returned to the imperial seat; shot at the suspended target; when again complete, all officials then shot five ranges.

sentences.zh: 一品二品三十發，一發調馬，十發射下，十發射上，三發射麞，三發射帖，三發射獸頭。

translations.literal: First and second rank thirty shots: one to adjust the horse, ten shooting low, ten shooting high, three shooting deer, three shooting target, three shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: First and second rank thirty shots: one to adjust the horse, ten shooting low, ten shooting high, three shooting deer, three shooting target, three shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 三品二十五發，一發調馬，五發射下，十發射上，三發射麞，三發射帖，三發射獸頭。

translations.literal: Third rank twenty-five shots: one to adjust the horse, five shooting low, ten shooting high, three shooting deer, three shooting target, three shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank twenty-five shots: one to adjust the horse, five shooting low, ten shooting high, three shooting deer, three shooting target, three shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 四品二十發一發調馬，五發射下，八發射上，二發射麞，二發射帖，二發射獸頭。

translations.literal: Fourth rank twenty shots: one to adjust the horse, five shooting low, eight shooting high, two shooting deer, two shooting target, two shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth rank twenty shots: one to adjust the horse, five shooting low, eight shooting high, two shooting deer, two shooting target, two shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 五品十五發一發調馬，四發射下，五發射上，二發射麞，二發射帖，一發射獸頭。

translations.literal: Fifth rank fifteen shots: one to adjust the horse, four shooting low, five shooting high, two shooting deer, two shooting target, one shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth rank fifteen shots: one to adjust the horse, four shooting low, five shooting high, two shooting deer, two shooting target, one shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 侍官禦仗已上十發一發調馬，四發射下，五發射上。

translations.literal: Attendants and imperial guard and above ten shots: one to adjust the horse, four shooting low, five shooting high.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants and imperial guard and above ten shots: one to adjust the horse, four shooting low, five shooting high.

sentences.zh: 季秋大射，皇帝備大駕，常服，禦七寶輦，射七埒。

translations.literal: In late autumn grand archery, the emperor prepared the grand carriage, regular dress, rode the seven-treasure palanquin, shot seven ranges.
translations.idiomatic: In late autumn grand archery, the emperor prepared the grand carriage, regular dress, rode the seven-treasure palanquin, shot seven ranges.

sentences.zh: 正三品已上，第一埒，一品五十發，一發調馬，十五發射下，二十五發射上，三發射麞，三發射帖，三發射獸頭。

translations.literal: From regular third rank and above, the first range: first rank fifty shots, one to adjust the horse, fifteen shooting low, twenty-five shooting high, three shooting deer, three shooting target, three shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: From regular third rank and above, the first range: first rank fifty shots, one to adjust the horse, fifteen shooting low, twenty-five shooting high, three shooting deer, three shooting target, three shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 二品四十六發一發調馬，十五發射下，二十二發射上，二發射麞，三發射帖，三發射獸頭。

translations.literal: Second rank forty-six shots: one to adjust the horse, fifteen shooting low, twenty-two shooting high, two shooting deer, three shooting target, three shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: Second rank forty-six shots: one to adjust the horse, fifteen shooting low, twenty-two shooting high, two shooting deer, three shooting target, three shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 從三品四品第二埒，三品四十二發一發調馬，十二發射下，二十二發射上，二發射麞，二發射帖，三發射獸頭。

translations.literal: From third rank and fourth rank the second range: third rank forty-two shots, one to adjust the horse, twelve shooting low, twenty-two shooting high, two shooting deer, two shooting target, three shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: From third rank and fourth rank the second range: third rank forty-two shots, one to adjust the horse, twelve shooting low, twenty-two shooting high, two shooting deer, two shooting target, three shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 四品三十七發一發調馬，十一發射下，十九發射上，一發射麞，二發射帖，三發射獸頭。

translations.literal: Fourth rank thirty-seven shots: one to adjust the horse, eleven shooting low, nineteen shooting high, one shooting deer, two shooting target, three shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth rank thirty-seven shots: one to adjust the horse, eleven shooting low, nineteen shooting high, one shooting deer, two shooting target, three shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 五品第三埒，三十二發一發調馬，九發射下，十七發射上，一發射麞，二發射帖，二發射獸頭。

translations.literal: Fifth rank the third range, thirty-two shots: one to adjust the horse, nine shooting low, seventeen shooting high, one shooting deer, two shooting target, two shooting beast head.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth rank the third range, thirty-two shots: one to adjust the horse, nine shooting low, seventeen shooting high, one shooting deer, two shooting target, two shooting beast head.

sentences.zh: 六品第四埒，二十七發。

translations.literal: Sixth rank the fourth range, twenty-seven shots.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth rank the fourth range, twenty-seven shots.

sentences.zh: 一發調馬，八發射下，十六發射上，一發射麞，一發射帖。

translations.literal: One to adjust the horse, eight shooting low, sixteen shooting high, one shooting deer, one shooting target.
translations.idiomatic: One to adjust the horse, eight shooting low, sixteen shooting high, one shooting deer, one shooting target.

sentences.zh: 七品第五埒，二十一發一發調馬，六發射下，十二發射上，一發射麞，一發射帖。

translations.literal: Seventh rank the fifth range, twenty-one shots: one to adjust the horse, six shooting low, twelve shooting high, one shooting deer, one shooting target.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh rank the fifth range, twenty-one shots: one to adjust the horse, six shooting low, twelve shooting high, one shooting deer, one shooting target.

sentences.zh: 八品第六埒，十六發一發調馬，四發射下，九發射上，一發射麞，一發射帖。

translations.literal: Eighth rank the sixth range, sixteen shots: one to adjust the horse, four shooting low, nine shooting high, one shooting deer, one shooting target.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth rank the sixth range, sixteen shots: one to adjust the horse, four shooting low, nine shooting high, one shooting deer, one shooting target.

sentences.zh: 九品第七埒，十發。

translations.literal: Ninth rank the seventh range, ten shots.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth rank the seventh range, ten shots.

sentences.zh: 一發調馬，三發射下，四發射上，一發射麞，一發射帖。

translations.literal: One to adjust the horse, three shooting low, four shooting high, one shooting deer, one shooting target.
translations.idiomatic: One to adjust the horse, three shooting low, four shooting high, one shooting deer, one shooting target.

sentences.zh: 大射置大將太尉公為之。

translations.literal: Grand archery appointed the Grand General Grand Minister Duke to preside.
translations.idiomatic: Grand archery appointed the Grand General Grand Minister Duke to preside.

sentences.zh: 射司馬各一人，錄事二人。

translations.literal: One archery marshal each, two record clerks.
translations.idiomatic: One archery marshal each, two record clerks.

sentences.zh: 七埒各置埒將、射正參軍各一人，埒士四人，威儀一人，乘白馬以導，的別參軍一人，懸侯下府參軍一人。

translations.literal: Each of the seven ranges had one range general, one archery supervisor staff officer each, four range officers, one ceremonial officer, riding a white horse to guide; one target-section staff officer each, one suspended-target lower-office staff officer each.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the seven ranges had one range general, one archery supervisor staff officer each, four range officers, one ceremonial officer riding a white horse to guide; one target-section staff officer each, one suspended-target lower-office staff officer each.

sentences.zh: 又各置令史埒士等員，以司其事。

translations.literal: Again clerks, range officers, and other posts were established to manage the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Again clerks, range officers, and other posts were established to manage the affair.

sentences.zh: 後周仲春教振旅，大司馬建大麾于萊田之所。

translations.literal: Later Zhou in mid-spring taught rallying the army; the Grand Marshal erected the great banner at the cleared field site.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou in mid-spring taught rallying the army; the Grand Marshal erected the great banner at the cleared field site.

sentences.zh: 鄉稍之官，以旂物鼓鐸鉦鐃，各帥其人而致。

translations.literal: District and village officials, with banner objects, drums, bells, gongs, and nao, each led their people to arrive.
translations.idiomatic: District and village officials, with banner objects, drums, bells, gongs, and nao, each led their people to arrive.

sentences.zh: 誅其後至者。

translations.literal: Those arriving late were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Those arriving late were executed.

sentences.zh: 建麾於後表之中，以集眾庶。

translations.literal: The banner was erected at the center behind the marker to gather the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: The banner was erected at the center behind the marker to gather the multitude.

sentences.zh: 質明，偃麾，誅其不及者。

translations.literal: At dawn the banner was lowered; those not arriving were executed.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the banner was lowered; those not arriving were executed.

sentences.zh: 乃陳徒騎，如戰之陣。

translations.literal: Then foot and cavalry were arrayed as in battle formation.
translations.idiomatic: Then foot and cavalry were arrayed as in battle formation.

sentences.zh: 大司馬北面誓之。

translations.literal: The Grand Marshal faced north and administered the oath.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Marshal faced north and administered the oath.

sentences.zh: 軍中皆聽鼓角，以為進止之節。

translations.literal: Throughout the army all obeyed drums and horns as the rhythm of advance and halt.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the army all obeyed drums and horns as the rhythm of advance and halt.

sentences.zh: 田之日，於所萊之北，建旗為和門。

translations.literal: On the hunt day, north of the cleared area a banner was erected as harmony gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the hunt day, north of the cleared area a banner was erected as harmony gate.

sentences.zh: 諸將帥徒騎序入其門。

translations.literal: Generals and commanders of foot and cavalry entered the gate in order.
translations.idiomatic: Generals and commanders of foot and cavalry entered the gate in order.

sentences.zh: 有司居門，以平其人。

translations.literal: Officials stood at the gate to assess the men.
translations.idiomatic: Officials stood at the gate to assess the men.

sentences.zh: 既入而分其地，險野則待前而騎後，易野則騎前而徒後。

translations.literal: Having entered they divided the terrain: in rugged wilds cavalry waited in front and foot behind; in easy wilds cavalry in front and foot behind.
translations.idiomatic: Having entered they divided the terrain: in rugged wilds cavalry waited in front and foot behind; in easy wilds cavalry in front and foot behind.

sentences.zh: 既陣，皆坐，乃設驅逆騎，有司表狢於陣前。

translations.literal: When the formation was set all sat; then driving cavalry was set; the relevant office displayed the badger before the formation.
translations.idiomatic: When the formation was set all sat; then driving cavalry was set; the relevant office displayed the badger before the formation.

sentences.zh: 乙太牢祭黃帝軒轅氏，於狩地為墠，建二旗，列五兵於坐側，行三獻禮。

translations.literal: A full complement of sacrificial animals sacrificed to Xuanyuan the Yellow Emperor; at the hunt ground an altar was made, two banners erected, five weapons arrayed beside the seat, and the three offerings rite performed.
translations.idiomatic: A full complement of sacrificial animals sacrificed to Xuanyuan the Yellow Emperor; at the hunt ground an altar was made, two banners erected, five weapons arrayed beside the seat, and the three offerings rite performed.

sentences.zh: 遂蒐田致禽以祭社。

translations.literal: Then the sou hunt collected game to sacrifice at the altar of soil.
translations.idiomatic: Then the sou hunt collected game to sacrifice at the altar of soil.

sentences.zh: 仲夏教茇舍，如振旅之陣，遂以苗田如蒐法，致禽以享礿。

translations.literal: In mid-summer they taught camping; like the rallying-the-army formation; then the miao hunt like the sou method collected game to offer at the yue sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-summer they taught camping; like the rallying-the-army formation; then the miao hunt like the sou method collected game to offer at the yue sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 仲秋教練兵，如振旅之陣，遂以獮田如蒐法，致禽以祀方。

translations.literal: In mid-autumn they taught drilling troops; like the rallying-the-army formation; then the xian hunt like the sou method collected game to sacrifice to the directional altar.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-autumn they taught drilling troops; like the rallying-the-army formation; then the xian hunt like the sou method collected game to sacrifice to the directional altar.

sentences.zh: 仲冬教大閱，如振旅之陣，遂以狩田如蒐法，致禽以享烝。

translations.literal: In mid-winter they taught the great review; like the rallying-the-army formation; then the shou hunt like the sou method collected game to offer at the winter sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-winter they taught the great review; like the rallying-the-army formation; then the shou hunt like the sou method collected game to offer at the winter sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 孟秋迎太白，候太白夕見於西方。

translations.literal: In the first month of autumn the Great White Star was welcomed; they awaited the evening appearance of the Great White Star in the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of autumn the Great White Star was welcomed; they awaited the evening appearance of the Great White Star in the west.

sentences.zh: 先見三日，大司馬戒期，遂建旗于陽武門外。

translations.literal: Three days before appearance, the Grand Marshal set the date; then a banner was erected outside Yangwu Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Three days before appearance, the Grand Marshal set the date; then a banner was erected outside Yangwu Gate.

sentences.zh: 司空除壇兆，有司薦毛血，登歌奏《昭夏》。

translations.literal: The Minister of Works cleared the altar site; the relevant office presented fur and blood; ascending song played "Bright Summer."
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Works cleared the altar site; the relevant office presented fur and blood; ascending song played "Bright Summer."

sentences.zh: 在位者拜，事畢出。

translations.literal: Those in attendance bowed; when affairs were complete they departed.
translations.idiomatic: Those in attendance bowed; when affairs were complete they departed.

sentences.zh: 其日中後十刻，六軍士馬，俱介胄集旗下。

translations.literal: At ten quarters after noon on that day, the six armies' soldiers and horses all in armor assembled below the banner.
translations.idiomatic: At ten quarters after noon on that day, the six armies' soldiers and horses all in armor assembled below the banner.

sentences.zh: 左右武伯督十二帥嚴街，侍臣文武，俱介胄奉迎。

translations.literal: Left and right martial defenders supervised the twelve commanders to secure the streets; attending ministers civil and military all in armor came to welcome.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right martial defenders supervised the twelve commanders to secure the streets; attending ministers civil and military all in armor came to welcome.

sentences.zh: 樂師撞黃鐘，右五鐘皆應。

translations.literal: The music master struck the yellow bell; the five bells on the right all responded.
translations.idiomatic: The music master struck the yellow bell; the five bells on the right all responded.

sentences.zh: 皇帝介胄，警蹕以出，如常儀而無鼓角，出國門而「Ｑ祭。

translations.literal: The emperor in armor, cleared by escort, came out as in regular ritual but without drums and horns; exiting the state gate the she sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in armor, cleared by escort, came out as in regular ritual but without drums and horns; exiting the state gate the she sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 至則舍於次。

translations.literal: Upon arrival he lodged at the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Upon arrival he lodged at the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 太白未見五刻，中外皆嚴，皇帝就位，六軍鼓噪，行三獻之禮。

translations.literal: Five quarters before the Great White Star appeared, inner and outer courts were all in full array; the emperor took his seat; the six armies drummed and shouted; the three offerings rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: Five quarters before the Great White Star appeared, inner and outer courts were all in full array; the emperor took his seat; the six armies drummed and shouted; the three offerings rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 每獻，鼓噪如初獻。

translations.literal: At each offering, drumming and shouting as at the first offering.
translations.idiomatic: At each offering, drumming and shouting as at the first offering.

sentences.zh: 事訖，燔燎賜胙，畢，鼓噪而還。

translations.literal: When affairs were complete, burning and conferring sacrificial meat; when complete, drumming and shouting while returning.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs were complete, burning and conferring sacrificial meat; when complete, drumming and shouting while returning.

sentences.zh: 隋制，大射祭射侯於射所，用少牢。

translations.literal: Under Sui regulations, grand archery sacrificed to the archery target at the archery ground, using the lesser complement.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui regulations, grand archery sacrificed to the archery target at the archery ground, using the lesser complement.

sentences.zh: 軍人每年孟秋閱戎具，仲冬教戰法。

translations.literal: Soldiers every year in the first month of autumn inspected military equipment; in mid-winter battle methods were taught.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers every year in the first month of autumn inspected military equipment; in mid-winter battle methods were taught.

sentences.zh: 及大業三年，煬帝在榆林，突厥啟民及西域、東胡君長，並來朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daye, Emperor Yang was at Yulin; Qimin of the Turks and chieftains of the Western Regions and Eastern Hu all came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Daye 3 (607), Emperor Yang was at Yulin; Qimin of the Turks and chieftains of the Western Regions and Eastern Hu all came to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝欲誇以甲兵之盛，乃命有司陳冬狩之禮。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to display the grandeur of armor and weapons; he ordered the relevant office to arrange the winter shou rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to display the grandeur of armor and weapons; he ordered the relevant office to arrange the winter shou rite.

sentences.zh: 詔虞部量拔延山南北週二百里，並立表記。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Parks to measure two hundred li around Bayan Mountain north and south and erect markers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of Parks to measure two hundred li around Bayan Mountain north and south and erect markers.

sentences.zh: 前狩二日，兵部建旗於表所。

translations.literal: Two days before the hunt, the Ministry of War erected banners at the marker site.
translations.idiomatic: Two days before the hunt, the Ministry of War erected banners at the marker site.

sentences.zh: 五裏一旗，分為四十軍，軍萬人，騎五千匹。

translations.literal: One banner every five li, divided into forty armies; each army ten thousand men, cavalry five thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: One banner every five li, divided into forty armies; each army ten thousand men, cavalry five thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 前一日，諸將各帥其軍，集於旗下。

translations.literal: One day before, each general led his army to assemble below the banner.
translations.idiomatic: One day before, each general led his army to assemble below the banner.

sentences.zh: 鳴鼓，後至者斬。

translations.literal: Drums sounded; those arriving late were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Drums sounded; those arriving late were executed.

sentences.zh: 詔四十道使，並揚旗建節，分申佃令，即留軍所監獵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered forty envoys each to raise banners and hold credentials, separately conveying field orders; they remained at the army sites to supervise the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered forty envoys each to raise banners and hold credentials, separately conveying field orders; they remained at the army sites to supervise the hunt.

sentences.zh: 布圍，圍闕南面，方行而前。

translations.literal: The enclosure was spread; the enclosure left the south open; they advanced in square formation.
translations.idiomatic: The enclosure was spread; the enclosure left the south open; they advanced in square formation.

sentences.zh: 帝服紫袴褶、黑介幘，乘闟豬車，其飾如木輅，重輞漫輪，虯龍繞轂，漢東京鹵簿所謂獵車者也。

translations.literal: The emperor wore purple trousers and jacket, black headcloth, rode the gate-pig cart—its decoration like the wooden chariot, heavy rim covered wheel, horned dragon coiling the hub—the hunt cart called by the Eastern Han capital guard procession.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore purple trousers and jacket, black headcloth, rode the gate-pig cart—its decoration like the wooden chariot, heavy rim covered wheel, horned dragon coiling the hub—the hunt cart called by the Eastern Han capital guard procession.

sentences.zh: 駕六黑鳷。

translations.literal: Six black zhi horses drew it.
translations.idiomatic: Six black zhi horses drew it.

sentences.zh: 太常陳鼓笳鐃簫角於帝左右，各百二十。

translations.literal: The Minister of Ceremonies arranged drums, horns, nao, pipes, and horns at the emperor's left and right, one hundred twenty each.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Ceremonies arranged drums, horns, nao, pipes, and horns at the emperor's left and right, one hundred twenty each.

sentences.zh: 百官戎服騎從，鼓行入圍。

translations.literal: The hundred officials in military dress rode in attendance; drumming they entered the enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials in military dress rode in attendance; drumming they entered the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 諸將並鼓行赴圍。

translations.literal: All generals also drummed marching to the enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: All generals also drummed marching to the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 乃設驅逆騎千有二百。

translations.literal: Then one thousand two hundred driving cavalry were set.
translations.idiomatic: Then one thousand two hundred driving cavalry were set.

sentences.zh: 闟豬停軔，有司斂大綏，王公已下，皆整弓矢，陳於駕前。

translations.literal: The gate-pig halted the axle; the relevant office gathered the great rein; from princes and dukes down all adjusted bows and arrows and arrayed before the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The gate-pig halted the axle; the relevant office gathered the great rein; from princes and dukes down all adjusted bows and arrows and arrayed before the carriage.

sentences.zh: 有司又斂小綏，乃驅獸出，過於帝前。

translations.literal: The relevant office again gathered the small rein; then game was driven out, passing before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office again gathered the small rein; then game was driven out, passing before the emperor.

sentences.zh: 初驅過，有司整禦弓矢以前，待詔。

translations.literal: At the first drive passing, the relevant office adjusted the imperial bow and arrows and advanced, awaiting command.
translations.idiomatic: At the first drive passing, the relevant office adjusted the imperial bow and arrows and advanced, awaiting command.

sentences.zh: 再驅過，備身將軍奉進弓矢。

translations.literal: At the second drive passing, the bodyguard general presented the bow and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: At the second drive passing, the bodyguard general presented the bow and arrows.

sentences.zh: 三驅過，帝乃從禽，鼓吹皆振，坐而射之。

translations.literal: At the third drive passing, the emperor then hunted; wind music all sounded; seated he shot.
translations.idiomatic: At the third drive passing, the emperor then hunted; wind music all sounded; seated he shot.

sentences.zh: 每驅必三獸以上。

translations.literal: Each drive had to have three beasts or more.
translations.idiomatic: Each drive had to have three beasts or more.

sentences.zh: 帝發，抗大綏。

translations.literal: When the emperor shot, he raised the great rein.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor shot, he raised the great rein.

sentences.zh: 次王公發，則抗小綏。

translations.literal: Next when princes and dukes shot, they raised the small rein.
translations.idiomatic: Next when princes and dukes shot, they raised the small rein.

sentences.zh: 次諸將發射之，無鼓，驅逆之騎乃止。

translations.literal: Next when generals shot, there was no drum; the driving cavalry then halted.
translations.idiomatic: Next when generals shot, there was no drum; the driving cavalry then halted.

sentences.zh: 然後三軍四夷百姓皆獵。

translations.literal: Then the three armies, four barbarian peoples, and common people all hunted.
translations.idiomatic: Then the three armies, four barbarian peoples, and common people all hunted.

sentences.zh: 凡射獸，自左膘而射之，達於右腢，為上等。

translations.literal: Generally when shooting game, from the left flank toward the right haunch was top grade.
translations.idiomatic: Generally when shooting game, from the left flank toward the right haunch was top grade.

sentences.zh: 達右耳本，為次等。

translations.literal: Reaching the base of the right ear was second grade.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the base of the right ear was second grade.

sentences.zh: 自左髀達於右鋋為下等。

translations.literal: From the left thigh reaching the right shoulder blade was lowest grade.
translations.idiomatic: From the left thigh reaching the right shoulder blade was lowest grade.

sentences.zh: 群獸相從，不得盡殺。

translations.literal: When beasts ran together, they must not all be killed.
translations.idiomatic: When beasts ran together, they must not all be killed.

sentences.zh: 已傷之獸，不得重射。

translations.literal: Already wounded beasts must not be shot again.
translations.idiomatic: Already wounded beasts must not be shot again.

sentences.zh: 又逆向人者，不射其面。

translations.literal: Also those facing toward people must not be shot in the face.
translations.idiomatic: Also those facing toward people must not be shot in the face.

sentences.zh: 出表者不逐之。

translations.literal: Those exiting the marker were not pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Those exiting the marker were not pursued.

sentences.zh: 佃將止，虞部建旗於圍內。

translations.literal: The field general halted; the Ministry of Parks erected banners within the enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The field general halted; the Ministry of Parks erected banners within the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 從駕之鼓及諸軍鼓俱振，卒徒皆噪。

translations.literal: The escort drums and all army drums all sounded; foot soldiers all shouted.
translations.idiomatic: The escort drums and all army drums all sounded; foot soldiers all shouted.

sentences.zh: 諸獲禽者，獻於旗所，致其左耳。

translations.literal: Those who obtained game presented at the banner site, presenting the left ear.
translations.idiomatic: Those who obtained game presented at the banner site, presenting the left ear.

sentences.zh: 大獸公之，以供宗廟，使歸，薦臘于京師。

translations.literal: Large game was public property, supplied to the ancestral temple; envoys returned, presenting winter sacrifice at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Large game was public property, supplied to the ancestral temple; envoys returned, presenting winter sacrifice at the capital.

sentences.zh: 小獸私之。

translations.literal: Small game was private property.
translations.idiomatic: Small game was private property.

sentences.zh: 齊制，季冬晦，選樂人子弟十歲以上十二以下為侲子，合二百四十人。

translations.literal: Qi regulations: on the last day of the twelfth month, musician youths ten years and above twelve and below were selected as nuo youths, two hundred forty total.
translations.idiomatic: Qi regulations: on the last day of the twelfth month, musician youths ten years and above twelve and below were selected as nuo youths, two hundred forty total.

sentences.zh: 一百二十人，赤幘、皁褠衣，執鞀。

translations.literal: One hundred twenty wore red headcloths and black jackets, holding hand drums.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty wore red headcloths and black jackets, holding hand drums.

sentences.zh: 一百二十人赤布褲褶，執鞞角。

translations.literal: One hundred twenty wore red cloth trousers and jackets, holding leather horns.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty wore red cloth trousers and jackets, holding leather horns.

sentences.zh: 方相氏黃金四目，熊皮蒙首，玄衣硃裳，執戈揚楯。

translations.literal: The fangxiang with four golden eyes, bear skin covering the head, dark robes and vermilion skirt, held spear and raised shield.
translations.idiomatic: The fangxiang with four golden eyes, bear skin covering the head, dark robes and vermilion skirt, held spear and raised shield.

sentences.zh: 又作窮奇、祖明之類，凡十二獸，皆有毛角。

translations.literal: Again qiongqi, zuming, and similar types were made—twelve beasts in all, all with hair and horns.
translations.idiomatic: Again qiongqi, zuming, and similar types were made—twelve beasts in all, all with hair and horns.

sentences.zh: 鼓吹令率之，中黃門行之，冗從僕射將之，以逐惡鬼于禁中。

translations.literal: The Director of Wind Music led them; palace attendants walked; the Supernumerary Master of the Household commanded them—to drive away evil spirits in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Wind Music led them; palace attendants walked; the Supernumerary Master of the Household commanded them—to drive away evil spirits in the palace.

sentences.zh: 其日戊夜三唱，開諸裏門，儺者各集，被服器仗以待事。

translations.literal: On that day at the third watch of the wu night three announcements; all inner lanes opened; nuo performers each assembled, donned garments and took up implements awaiting the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On that day at the third watch of the wu night three announcements; all inner lanes opened; nuo performers each assembled, donned garments and took up implements awaiting the affair.

sentences.zh: 戊夜四唱，開諸城門，二衛皆嚴。

translations.literal: At the fourth watch of the wu night all city gates opened; both guards were in full array.
translations.idiomatic: At the fourth watch of the wu night all city gates opened; both guards were in full array.

sentences.zh: 上水一刻，皇帝常服，即御座。

translations.literal: One quarter after the water clock at night, the emperor in regular dress took the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: One quarter after the water clock at night, the emperor in regular dress took the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 王公執事官第一品已下、從六品已上，陪列預觀。

translations.literal: From princes and dukes, executing officials of first rank and above, from sixth rank and above, accompanied in array to observe.
translations.idiomatic: From princes and dukes, executing officials of first rank and above, from sixth rank and above, accompanied in array to observe.

sentences.zh: 儺者鼓噪，入殿西門，遍於禁內。

translations.literal: The nuo performers drummed and shouted, entering the west gate of the hall, throughout the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: The nuo performers drummed and shouted, entering the west gate of the hall, throughout the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 分出二上閣，作方相與十二獸儛戲，喧呼周遍，前後鼓噪。

translations.literal: Splitting to the two upper pavilions, the fangxiang and twelve beasts performed the nuo dance, shouting throughout, drumming and shouting front and back.
translations.idiomatic: Splitting to the two upper pavilions, the fangxiang and twelve beasts performed the nuo dance, shouting throughout, drumming and shouting front and back.

sentences.zh: 出殿南門，分為六道，出於郭外。

translations.literal: Exiting the south gate of the hall, divided into six routes, exiting outside the outer wall.
translations.idiomatic: Exiting the south gate of the hall, divided into six routes, exiting outside the outer wall.

sentences.zh: 隋制，季春晦，儺，磔牲于宮門及城四門，以禳陰氣。

translations.literal: Under Sui regulations, on the last day of the third month, nuo; victims were dismembered at the palace gate and four city gates to dispel yin energy.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui regulations, on the last day of the third month, nuo; victims were dismembered at the palace gate and four city gates to dispel yin energy.

sentences.zh: 秋分前一日，禳陽氣。

translations.literal: One day before the autumn equinox, yang energy was dispelled.
translations.idiomatic: One day before the autumn equinox, yang energy was dispelled.

sentences.zh: 季冬傍磔、大儺亦如之。

translations.literal: Late winter side dismemberment and great nuo were also the same.
translations.idiomatic: Late winter side dismemberment and great nuo were also the same.

sentences.zh: 其牲，每門各用羝羊及雄雞一。

translations.literal: For victims, each gate used one ram and one rooster.
translations.idiomatic: For victims, each gate used one ram and one rooster.

sentences.zh: 選侲子如後齊。

translations.literal: Nuo youths were selected as in Later Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Nuo youths were selected as in Later Qi.

sentences.zh: 冬八隊，二時儺則四隊。

translations.literal: Winter eight companies; the two seasonal nuo had four companies.
translations.idiomatic: Winter eight companies; the two seasonal nuo had four companies.

sentences.zh: 問事十二人，赤幘褠衣，執皮鞭。

translations.literal: Twelve questioners wore red headcloths and jackets, holding leather whips.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve questioners wore red headcloths and jackets, holding leather whips.

sentences.zh: 工人二十二人。

translations.literal: Twenty-two craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-two craftsmen.

sentences.zh: 其一人方相氏，黃金四目，蒙熊皮，玄衣硃裳。

translations.literal: One was the fangxiang, four golden eyes, covered with bear skin, dark robes and vermilion skirt.
translations.idiomatic: One was the fangxiang, four golden eyes, covered with bear skin, dark robes and vermilion skirt.

sentences.zh: 其一人為唱師，著皮衣，執棒。

translations.literal: One was the chant master, wearing leather garments, holding a staff.
translations.idiomatic: One was the chant master, wearing leather garments, holding a staff.

sentences.zh: 鼓角各十。

translations.literal: Drums and horns ten each.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten drums and ten horns apiece.

sentences.zh: 有司預備雄雞羝羊及酒，于宮門為坎。

translations.literal: The relevant office prepared roosters, rams, and wine in advance at the palace gate in a pit.
translations.idiomatic: Officials prepared roosters, rams, and wine beforehand in a pit at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 未明，鼓噪以入。

translations.literal: Before dawn, drumming and shouting they entered.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn they entered, drumming and shouting.

sentences.zh: 方相氏執戈揚楯，周呼鼓噪而出，合趣顯陽門，分詣諸城門。

translations.literal: The fangxiang held spear and raised shield, circling shouting and drumming out; together they hastened to Xianyang Gate, separately proceeding to the various city gates.
translations.idiomatic: The fangxiang exorcist held spear and raised shield, circling with shouts and drums as they went out; together they hurried to Xianyang Gate, then split up toward the various city gates.

sentences.zh: 將出，諸祝師執事，預副牲胸，磔之於門，酌酒禳祝。

translations.literal: About to exit, invocators and executors in advance cut the victims' breast, dismembering at the gate; wine was poured for exorcistic prayer.
translations.idiomatic: Just before exiting, invocators and executors cut open the victims' breast and dismembered them at the gate, then poured wine for exorcistic prayer.

sentences.zh: 舉牲並酒埋之。

translations.literal: Victims and wine together were buried.
translations.idiomatic: The victims and wine were buried together.

sentences.zh: 後齊制，日蝕，則太極殿西廂東向，東堂東廂西向，各設御座。

translations.literal: Later Qi regulations: on solar eclipse, at the west wing of Taiji Hall facing east, at the east hall east wing facing west, imperial seats were each set.
translations.idiomatic: Under Later Qi regulations, during a solar eclipse imperial seats were set in the west wing of Taiji Hall facing east and in the east hall's east wing facing west.

sentences.zh: 群官公服。

translations.literal: All officials wore public garments.
translations.idiomatic: All officials wore their public court garments.

sentences.zh: 晝漏上水一刻，內外皆嚴。

translations.literal: One quarter after the day water clock, inner and outer courts were all in full array.
translations.idiomatic: One quarter after the day water clock sounded, the inner and outer courts were fully assembled.

sentences.zh: 三門者閉中門，單門者掩之。

translations.literal: Those with three gates closed the middle gate; those with single gates closed them.
translations.idiomatic: Where there were three gates, the middle gate was closed; where there was only one gate, it was shut.

sentences.zh: 蝕前三刻，皇帝服通天冠，即御座，直衛如常，不省事。

translations.literal: Three quarters before the eclipse, the emperor wore the tongtian cap, took the imperial seat; direct guard as usual, not attending to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Three quarters before the eclipse, the emperor put on the tongtian cap and took the imperial seat; the direct guard stood as usual, and he did not conduct state business.

sentences.zh: 有變，聞鼓音，則避正殿，就東堂，服白袷單衣。

translations.literal: When there was change, hearing the drum sound, he avoided the main hall, went to the east hall, wore white lined unlined garment.
translations.idiomatic: When the eclipse began, at the sound of the drum he left the main hall for the east hall and wore a white lined unlined garment.

sentences.zh: 侍臣皆赤幘，帶劍，升殿侍。

translations.literal: Attending ministers all wore red headcloths, girded swords, ascended the hall to attend.
translations.idiomatic: Attending ministers all wore red headcloths, girded swords, and ascended the hall to attend him.

sentences.zh: 諸司各於其所，赤幘，持劍，出戶向日立。

translations.literal: Each office at its post wore red headcloths, held swords, went out the door and stood facing the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Each office at its post wore red headcloths, held swords, went out the door, and stood facing the sun.

sentences.zh: 有司各率官屬，並行宮內諸門、掖門，屯衛太社。

translations.literal: The relevant office each led subordinates, also proceeding through inner palace gates, side gates, encamping and guarding the Grand Altar of Soil.
translations.idiomatic: Each relevant office led its subordinates through the inner palace gates and side gates to encamp and guard the Grand Altar of Soil.

sentences.zh: 鄴令以官屬圍社，守四門，以硃絲繩繞系社壇三匝。

translations.literal: The Ye Prefect with subordinates encircled the altar, guarding the four gates, with vermilion silk cord wound three times around the altar.
translations.idiomatic: The Ye Prefect and his subordinates encircled the altar, guarding the four gates, with vermilion silk cord wound three times around the altar mound.

sentences.zh: 太祝令陳辭責社。

translations.literal: The Grand Invocator ordered the invocation rebuking the altar.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Invocator recited the invocation rebuking the altar.

sentences.zh: 太史令二人，走馬露版上尚書，門司疾上之。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Astronomy ran horses exposing the report board to the Minister, the gate office urgently submitting it.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of Astronomy rode at full speed to expose the report board to the Minister, and the gate office urgently forwarded it.

sentences.zh: 又告清都尹鳴鼓，如嚴鼓法。

translations.literal: Again informing the Director of the Capital to sound drums, as in the strict drum method.
translations.idiomatic: They also informed the Director of the Capital to sound the drums according to the strict drum method.

sentences.zh: 日光復，乃止，奏解嚴。

translations.literal: When sunlight returned, it then stopped; memorial was submitted releasing strict array.
translations.idiomatic: When sunlight returned, the drums ceased and a memorial was submitted to release the strict array.

sentences.zh: 後魏每攻戰克捷，欲天下知聞，乃書帛，建於竿上，名為露布。

translations.literal: Later Wei whenever battle was won in attack, wishing the realm to know, they wrote on silk and erected it on a pole, called a dew report.
translations.idiomatic: In Later Wei, whenever an attack ended in victory and the court wished the realm to know, they wrote the news on silk and erected it on a pole—this was called a dew report.

sentences.zh: 其後相因施行。

translations.literal: Afterward this was successively implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward this practice was carried on in succession.

sentences.zh: 開皇中，乃詔太常卿牛弘、太子庶子裴政撰宣露布禮。

translations.literal: In Kaihuang, an edict ordered Minister of Ceremonies Niu Hong and Crown Prince Attendant Pei Zheng to compile the rite for proclaiming dew reports.
translations.idiomatic: During Kaihuang, an edict ordered Minister of Ceremonies Niu Hong and Crown Prince Attendant Pei Zheng to compile the rite for proclaiming dew reports.

sentences.zh: 及九年平陳，元帥晉王以驛上露布。

translations.literal: In the ninth year when Chen was pacified, the commander Prince Jin submitted the dew report by post station.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when Chen was pacified, the commander Prince Jin submitted the dew report by post station.

sentences.zh: 兵部奏，請依新禮宣行。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War memorialized, requesting according to the new rite to proclaim and execute.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War memorialized, requesting that the new rite be followed to proclaim and execute the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 承詔集百官、四方客使等，並赴廣陽門外，服朝衣，各依其列。

translations.literal: By edict all officials, envoys from the four directions and guests, all went to outside Guangyang Gate, wearing court dress, each according to their rank.
translations.idiomatic: By edict all officials, envoys from the four directions, and guests went to the area outside Guangyang Gate in court dress, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 內史令稱有詔，在位者皆拜。

translations.literal: The Director of the Secretariat announced there was an edict; those in attendance all bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Secretariat announced that an edict was to be read, and those in attendance all bowed.

sentences.zh: 宣訖，拜，蹈舞者三，又拜。

translations.literal: When proclamation was complete, they bowed; tread-dancers three times, again bowed.
translations.idiomatic: When the proclamation was complete, they bowed; the tread-dancers performed three times, and they bowed again.

sentences.zh: 郡縣亦同。

translations.literal: Commanderies and counties were also the same.
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies and counties followed the same procedure.
